name: vidnavigator
description: Read what is said in online videos, search YouTube and TikTok, and extract structured data from videos, through the hosted VidNavigator MCP server.

interface.longDescription:
VidNavigator lets ChatGPT read what is said in online videos, and the data around them.

Share a link and ask: ChatGPT reads the transcript of a YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X, Facebook, Vimeo, Dailymotion, Loom, Rumble or Snapchat video and answers with timestamps. When a video has no captions, VidNavigator transcribes its audio, whatever its length (YouTube excepted).

What ChatGPT can do with it:
- Transcripts and speech-to-text: the full text of a video, as timestamped segments.
- Summaries and questions: a summary, the people and subjects mentioned, or the answer to a question with the passage it comes from.
- Structured data: the fields you define (product, price, claims, sentiment...) extracted from one video or from many, ready for a table.
- YouTube search: videos ranked by how well their content matches a request, with the moment that matches, including videos that support or contradict a claim.
- TikTok research: keyword search by country, period and popularity, the videos of an account, the LIVE rooms broadcasting right now and their latest comments.
- Posts on X: the claim a post makes, including its attached video or images.
- Your files: search, summarize and extract data from the audio and video files you uploaded to VidNavigator.

VidNavigator reads speech and video details (title, creator, date, views). It does not look at the picture: text on screen and silent footage are out of reach.

You connect by signing in to your VidNavigator account and allowing ChatGPT. Every tool is read-only: ChatGPT cannot upload, change or delete anything in your account, and you can end the connection at any time in VidNavigator Studio.
capabilities: Read the transcript of an online video
Transcribe the audio of videos without captions
Summarize a video or answer a question about it, with timestamps
Search YouTube for videos and the moment that matches
Search TikTok videos, accounts and LIVE rooms
Search and analyze your uploaded audio and video files
defaultPrompt: Summarize this video in five points, with timestamps: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iG9CE55wbtY
Find the most liked TikToks about creatine gummies this month
Find a YouTube video where Neil deGrasse Tyson explains gravity

positive.description: Summarize a YouTube video from its transcript, with timestamps.
positive.prompt: Summarize this talk in five points, with a timestamp for each: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iG9CE55wbtY
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT reads the transcript of Sir Ken Robinson's TED talk "Do schools kill creativity?" (about 20 minutes) and answers with five points, each with an m:ss timestamp taken from the transcript.

positive.description: Extract structured fields from a video.
positive.prompt: From this talk, extract the speaker's name, the main thesis in one sentence, and the people mentioned: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iG9CE55wbtY
positive.expected_behavior: extract_video_data starts a background task; get_task_status returns the extracted fields. ChatGPT gives the speaker (Ken Robinson), a one-sentence thesis about schools and creativity, and a list of people mentioned in the talk, such as Gillian Lynne.

positive.description: Search YouTube for a video and the passage that matches the request.
positive.prompt: Find a YouTube video where Neil deGrasse Tyson explains gravity, and link the exact moment.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT lists a few YouTube videos of Neil deGrasse Tyson talking about gravity, each with its channel, date, why it matches, and a youtu.be link with a ?t= timestamp at the matching passage.

positive.description: Search TikTok by keyword, country, period and popularity.
positive.prompt: Find the five most liked TikToks about creatine gummies this month in the UK.
positive.expected_behavior: search_tiktok runs with sort_by most_liked, a one-month window and country gb; get_task_status returns the videos. ChatGPT gives a table of five TikToks with link, creator, date, views and likes, and states the query, country and period it searched.

positive.description: List the latest videos of a TikTok account.
positive.prompt: List the last three videos posted by https://www.tiktok.com/@nasa
positive.expected_behavior: scrape_tiktok_profile runs with max_posts 3; get_task_status returns the videos. ChatGPT lists three recent videos of the NASA TikTok account with link, publication date, views and likes.

negative.description: A request unrelated to videos must not call VidNavigator.
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT answers (Canberra) without calling any VidNavigator tool.

negative.description: A request to delete files must be declined: every VidNavigator tool is read-only.
negative.prompt: Delete all the files I uploaded to VidNavigator.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT explains that the VidNavigator tools can only read files and cannot delete them, and that files are managed in VidNavigator Studio. No file is deleted.

negative.description: A request to generate a video is outside what VidNavigator does.
negative.prompt: Use VidNavigator to create a 30-second video of a cat playing the piano.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT explains that VidNavigator reads and searches existing videos and cannot create one. No VidNavigator tool is called, or only to clarify what it can do.
